1.t: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly

2.t: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently

4.t: and those taking the lead vigorously

6.t: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass

8.t: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺

10.t: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state

11.t: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”

12.t: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”

13.t: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast

14.t: and at once they will be above ground

15.t: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺

16.t: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa
16.tr: Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil-waadil muqad-dasi tuwa

17.t: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺

18.t: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself
18.tr: Faqul hal laka ilaa an tazakka

19.t: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”

20.t: Then Moses showed him the great sign

22.t: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺

23.t: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out

24.t: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”

25.t: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next

26.t: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺
26.tr: Inna fee zaalika la'ibratal limaiy yaksha

27.t: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it
27.tr: A-antum a-shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha

28.t: raising it high and forming it flawlessly

29.t: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight

30.t: As for the earth, He spread it out as well

31.t: bringing forth its water and pastures

32.t: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—

33.t: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals

34.t: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—

35.t: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving

36.t: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—

37.t: then as for those who transgressed

38.t: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

39.t: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home

40.t: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires
40.tr: Wa-ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee Wa-nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa

42.t: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”

43.t: But it is not for you to tell its time

44.t: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺

45.t: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it

46.t: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning
46.tr: Ka-annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa
